paragraphs.source_en: With their cups filled with fine sake, father and sons began discussing the old affairs of the Takeda clan of Kai. From the Mōri in Bitchū and Hashiba Hideyoshi, and from Takamatsu Castle to the glory of defeating Imagawa Yoshimoto at Dengakuhazama, Nobunaga and his sons discoursed with spirited enthusiasm.

units.source_en: With their cups filled with fine sake, father and sons began discussing the old affairs of the Takeda clan of Kai.

units.source_en: From the Mōri in Bitchū and Hashiba Hideyoshi, and from Takamatsu Castle to the glory of defeating Imagawa Yoshimoto at Dengakuhazama, Nobunaga and his sons discoursed with spirited enthusiasm.
units.source_zh: 从备中的毛利和羽柴秀吉，再从高松城谈到在田乐洼击败今川义元的功劳，信长父子兴致勃勃，高谈阔论。

paragraphs.source_zh: 酒杯里斟满美酒，父子们开始探讨起甲州武田氏的旧事来。从备中的毛利和羽柴秀吉，再从高松城谈到在田乐洼击败今川义元的功劳，信长父子兴致勃勃，高谈阔论。

paragraphs.source_en: “Back then, I was twenty-seven—one year older than Nobutada is now. Wasn’t I, Nō?”

units.source_en: “Back then, I was twenty-seven—one year older than Nobutada is now. Wasn’t I, Nō?”
units.source_zh: “那时候，我比现在的信忠大一岁，是二十七岁，对吧，阿浓？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那时候，我比现在的信忠大一岁，是二十七岁，对吧，阿浓？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. You were a valiant and formidable warrior.”

units.source_en: “Yes. You were a valiant and formidable warrior.”
units.source_zh: “对，是一名骁勇善战的猛将。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “对，是一名骁勇善战的猛将。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I stood there and poured rice gruel straight into my mouth… Three bowls, wasn’t it?”

units.source_en: “I stood there and poured rice gruel straight into my mouth… Three bowls, wasn’t it?”
units.source_zh: “我站着就把泡饭倒进嘴里……好像吃了三碗吧？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我站着就把泡饭倒进嘴里……好像吃了三碗吧？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, three bowls in one breath.” Lady Nō seemed to remember those days fondly.

units.source_en: “Yes, three bowls in one breath.”
units.source_zh: “对，一口气吃了三碗。”

units.source_en: Lady Nō seemed to remember those days fondly.

units.source_zh: 浓夫人似很怀念当时。

paragraphs.source_en: Knowing that he was now thoroughly pleased with himself, Lady Nō began beating a small hand drum in accompaniment. The hand drum’s faintly uncanny rhythm mingled with Nobunaga’s resonant voice and echoed through the ancient temple.

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes, it struck me as odd as well. At this rate, we will reach the capital by midnight. We have taken quite a detour.”

paragraphs.source_en: The column therefore dispersed on Mount Kinugasa and began eating the provisions they had brought. That Lord Nobunaga wished to inspect the troops sounded perfectly reasonable, and not one man grew suspicious.

units.source_zh: 信长公要阅兵，听来也是顺理成章的事，没有一个人产生疑心。

paragraphs.source_zh: 队伍于是在衣笠山上就地解散，开始吃带来的干粮。信长公要阅兵，听来也是顺理成章的事，没有一个人产生疑心。

paragraphs.source_en: Great events always have some portent; it was this very remark that sealed the fate of Nobunaga and his son.

units.source_en: Great events always have some portent; it was this very remark that sealed the fate of Nobunaga and his son.
units.source_zh: 事件爆发之时总有某种前兆，正是这一句话，决定了信长父子的命运。

paragraphs.source_en: Samanosuke’s thirty-seven hundred men were to besiege Honnō-ji; Jizaemon’s force of over four thousand would attack Nijō Castle and Myōkaku-ji; and the main body of more than three thousand under Mitsuhide would strike Sanjō Horikawa. The whole army surged forth like a raging tide sweeping across the capital.

units.source_en: Samanosuke’s thirty-seven hundred men were to besiege Honnō-ji; Jizaemon’s force of over four thousand would attack Nijō Castle and Myōkaku-ji; and the main body of more than three thousand under Mitsuhide would strike Sanjō Horikawa.
units.source_zh: 左马助的三千七百人围攻本能寺，治左卫门的四千多人进攻二条城和妙觉寺，光秀率领的主力三千多人马则攻打三条堀河。

units.source_en: The whole army surged forth like a raging tide sweeping across the capital.
units.source_zh: 全军掀起一股席卷京城的狂潮。

paragraphs.source_zh: 左马助的三千七百人围攻本能寺，治左卫门的四千多人进攻二条城和妙觉寺，光秀率领的主力三千多人马则攻打三条堀河。全军掀起一股席卷京城的狂潮。

paragraphs.source_en: Mitsuhide now rode at the very front, leading his troops in their advance, yet he still seemed dazed: what, exactly, was he doing?

units.source_en: Mitsuhide now rode at the very front, leading his troops in their advance, yet he still seemed dazed: what, exactly, was he doing?

ja.t: めていたが、それでもまだ

units.source_zh: 此时的光秀一马当先，率兵突进，却似还在迷糊，自己究竟在干什么？

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时的光秀一马当先，率兵突进，却似还在迷糊，自己究竟在干什么？

paragraphs.source_en: A wise man understands the demands of his time. Once Mitsuhide understood this, he did not seek high office or rich stipends for his three daughters and four sons, but gave them ordinary positions and secure, peaceful lives. What an unpretentious father he was!

units.source_en: A wise man understands the demands of his time.
units.source_zh: 识时务者为俊杰。

units.source_en: Once Mitsuhide understood this, he did not seek high office or rich stipends for his three daughters and four sons, but gave them ordinary positions and secure, peaceful lives.
units.source_zh: 悟明这一点后，光秀没有为三女四男谋求高官厚禄，而是给了他们平凡的身份地位、安泰的生活环境。

units.source_en: What an unpretentious father he was!
units.source_zh: 多么朴实的父亲！

paragraphs.source_zh: 识时务者为俊杰。悟明这一点后，光秀没有为三女四男谋求高官厚禄，而是给了他们平凡的身份地位、安泰的生活环境。多么朴实的父亲！

paragraphs.source_en: How strange people are… Recalling all this, Mitsuhide kept reproaching himself inwardly: “Do you understand, Mitsuhide? If you fail to seize the realm, you will be nothing but a traitor, and your wife and children will be torn limb from limb.”

units.source_en: How strange people are… Recalling all this, Mitsuhide kept reproaching himself inwardly: “Do you understand, Mitsuhide?
units.source_zh: 人真是奇怪……想起这些，光秀就不断在心里责怪自己：“你明白吗，光秀？

units.source_en: If you fail to seize the realm, you will be nothing but a traitor, and your wife and children will be torn limb from limb.”

units.source_zh: 如果夺取不了天下，你就只能是一个谋叛者，你的妻儿都要落得五马分尸的下场。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 人真是奇怪……想起这些，光秀就不断在心里责怪自己：“你明白吗，光秀？如果夺取不了天下，你就只能是一个谋叛者，你的妻儿都要落得五马分尸的下场。”

paragraphs.source_en: Thus Mitsuhide’s three columns reached the capital around the Hour of the Rat—or, to be precise, after the second day of the sixth month had begun. Only after smashing through every wooden gate and entering the city streets did the troops raise their banners and begin moving according to plan.

units.source_en: Thus Mitsuhide’s three columns reached the capital around the Hour of the Rat—or, to be precise, after the second day of the sixth month had begun.
units.source_zh: 就这样，光秀的三队人马到达京城，已是子时左右，准确地说，已是六月初二。

units.source_en: Only after smashing through every wooden gate and entering the city streets did the troops raise their banners and begin moving according to plan.
units.source_zh: 军队打破所有的木门，进入城里的街道，才打起旗号来，按照预定计划行动。

paragraphs.source_zh: 就这样，光秀的三队人马到达京城，已是子时左右，准确地说，已是六月初二。军队打破所有的木门，进入城里的街道，才打起旗号来，按照预定计划行动。

paragraphs.source_en: The most tense of the three forces was surely that of Akechi Samanosuke Mitsuharu, charged with launching a surprise attack on Honnō-ji, Nobunaga’s lodging. In darkness so deep that they could not see their hands before their faces, the men struggled through thorn-choked thickets and bamboo groves around Honnō-ji, then followed the black line of the moat and sealed the temple off completely. The first encircling line was commanded by Shitennō Tajima-no-kami; the second by Murakami Izumi-no-kami and Tsumaki Kazue-no-kami; and the third by Miyake Shikibu.

units.source_en: The most tense of the three forces was surely that of Akechi Samanosuke Mitsuharu, charged with launching a surprise attack on Honnō-ji, Nobunaga’s lodging.
units.source_zh: 其中最紧张的一队，当属偷袭信长的下处本能寺的明智左马助光春。

units.source_en: In darkness so deep that they could not see their hands before their faces, the men struggled through thorn-choked thickets and bamboo groves around Honnō-ji, then followed the black line of the moat and sealed the temple off completely.
units.source_zh: 在伸手不见五指的黑夜中，队伍艰苦地穿越本能寺周围荆棘丛生的灌木丛和竹林，沿着黑糊糊的壕沟，将本能寺围了个水泄不通。

units.source_en: The first encircling line was commanded by Shitennō Tajima-no-kami; the second by Murakami Izumi-no-kami and Tsumaki Kazue-no-kami; and the third by Miyake Shikibu.
units.source_zh: 第一道包围圈是四王天但马守，第二道是村上和泉守和妻木主计头，第三道则是三宅式部。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其中最紧张的一队，当属偷袭信长的下处本能寺的明智左马助光春。在伸手不见五指的黑夜中，队伍艰苦地穿越本能寺周围荆棘丛生的灌木丛和竹林，沿着黑糊糊的壕沟，将本能寺围了个水泄不通。第一道包围圈是四王天但马守，第二道是村上和泉守和妻木主计头，第三道则是三宅式部。

paragraphs.source_en: The matter was urgent: if word leaked and Nobunaga’s reinforcements unexpectedly reached Honnō-ji, the whole enterprise would be ruined. With this deployment, however, even if reinforcements came, they could be held outside the temple.

units.source_en: The matter was urgent: if word leaked and Nobunaga’s reinforcements unexpectedly reached Honnō-ji, the whole enterprise would be ruined.
units.source_zh: 因为事情紧急，一旦走漏风声，信长的援军出其不意地增援本能寺，便将坏事。

units.source_en: With this deployment, however, even if reinforcements came, they could be held outside the temple.
units.source_zh: 而这样的部署，援军即使来了，也可以将其阻挡在本能寺之外。

paragraphs.source_zh: 因为事情紧急，一旦走漏风声，信长的援军出其不意地增援本能寺，便将坏事。而这样的部署，援军即使来了，也可以将其阻挡在本能寺之外。

paragraphs.source_en: “Good! Dawn comes early in summer. Before broad daylight, the entire army must storm the temple in one stroke and take Nobunaga’s head.” The order was immediately conveyed to Samanosuke. It was nearly the Hour of the Tiger. The occupants of Honnō-ji had only recently fallen asleep, and all around lay silent.

units.source_en: “Good!

units.source_zh: 已近寅时，本能寺里的人刚入睡不久，四周一片静寂。

paragraphs.source_zh: “好！夏天天亮得早，全军必须在天大亮之前，一举冲进，取下信长的首级。”命令立刻传给了左马助。已近寅时，本能寺里的人刚入睡不久，四周一片静寂。

paragraphs.source_en: Samanosuke gave the order to attack.

paragraphs.source_en: Most of the soldiers did not know what they were fighting for. The victor becomes lord and the defeated man a villain; to survive, one can only overcome the enemy. The warriors who lived each day by sword and spear understood that reality; the instant they heard the command to charge, they raised a heaven-shaking roar and raced one another to the walls.

units.source_en: Most of the soldiers did not know what they were fighting for.

units.source_zh: 为何而战，是大多数士兵所不知的。

units.source_zh: 胜者为王败者寇，想生存，只有战胜敌人。

units.source_en: The warriors who lived each day by sword and spear understood that reality; the instant they heard the command to charge, they raised a heaven-shaking roar and raced one another to the walls.

paragraphs.source_zh: 为何而战，是大多数士兵所不知的。胜者为王败者寇，想生存，只有战胜敌人。天天使刀弄枪的武夫在这样的现实中生存，一听到冲锋的军令，立刻发出震天的呐喊，争先恐后地冲到围墙前面。

paragraphs.source_en: Within Honnō-ji’s grounds, which covered some ten thousand tsubo, all was lifelessly still—so still it made the flesh creep. The pungent smell of honey-locust trees hung everywhere, while stars flickered in and out among the treetops.

units.source_zh: “杀呀，冲啊！”

paragraphs.source_en: Deep in sleep, Nobunaga suddenly sensed that something was wrong and sprang upright. After sending Nobutada and Genzaburō away, Nobunaga’s appetite for drink had not abated; he had continued exchanging cups with the women until late at night and had fallen dead drunk.

paragraphs.source_en: “Who is it?” He bellowed toward the adjoining room, “You people always quarrel when you’re drunk. What is all this noise? Shut your mouths, every one of you!”

units.source_zh: 他冲着旁边的房间大喊，“你们这些人一喝醉就吵架，吵什么吵，都给我闭嘴！”

paragraphs.source_en: When Nobunaga had launched his surprise attack on Imagawa Yoshimoto at Dengakuhazama, Yoshimoto had mistaken the commotion for a quarrel among his retainers. Tonight, the very same scene was being repeated around Nobunaga himself.

units.source_en: When Nobunaga had launched his surprise attack on Imagawa Yoshimoto at Dengakuhazama, Yoshimoto had mistaken the commotion for a quarrel among his retainers. Tonight, the very same scene was being repeated around Nobunaga himself.

paragraphs.source_en: Hearing his voice, Mori Ranmaru, Ogawa Aihei, Iikawa Miyamatsu, and the others in the next room all rose.

units.source_en: Hearing his voice, Mori Ranmaru, Ogawa Aihei, Iikawa Miyamatsu, and the others in the next room all rose.
